",n(r.p,{children:"When evaluating AR adoption, many teams start by comparing devices. Apple Vision Pro, HoloLens 2, and ruggedized mobile devices each have strengths and trade-offs. But hardware alone does not determine success."}),"

",i(r.h3,{id:"apple-vision-pro-immersive-high-end-but-with-constraints",children:["Apple Vision Pro: immersive, high-end, but with constraints",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#apple-vision-pro-immersive-high-end-but-with-constraints",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Apple Vision Pro introduces a new level of visual fidelity and spatial computing. The device excels at rendering complex 3D models and immersive environments. For design visualization, remote collaboration, and certain types of training, it sets a new standard."}),"

",n(r.p,{children:"Industrial AR adoption is not about chasing the latest device. It is about enabling smarter, safer, faster work in specific, high-impact scenarios."}),"
",n(r.p,{children:n(r.strong,{children:"Examples:"})}),"

",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"Onboarding and training:"})," New technicians follow interactive AR SOPs, with contextual tips and safety reminders, accelerating time to competency."]}),"

title: AR in logistics: guided picking, packing and loading for fewer mistakes
description: How AR-guided work instructions reduce errors and improve efficiency in logistics processes for operations, HSE, and training leaders.

image.alt: AR in logistics: guided picking, packing and loading for fewer mistakes

author: ActARion
body:
const{Fragment:e,jsx:i,jsxs:n}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(r){const a={a:"a",blockquote:"blockquote",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",li:"li",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...r.components};return n(e,{children:[n(a.h1,{id:"ar-in-logistics-guided-picking-packing-and-loading-for-fewer-mistakes",children:["AR in logistics: guided picking, packing and loading for fewer mistakes",i(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#ar-in-logistics-guided-picking-packing-and-loading-for-fewer-mistakes",children:i(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(a.p,{children:"Modern logistics operations face relentless pressure to deliver faster, safer, and with near-zero errors. Picking the wrong item, mispacking an order, or loading goods incorrectly can trigger costly delays, rework, and even safety incidents. For operations managers, HSE leaders, and training specialists, the challenge is clear: how can you enable teams to work smarter and more accurately, even as product complexity and order volumes rise?"}),"
",i(a.p,{children:"AI and AR–guided work instructions are emerging as a practical solution. By providing precise, step-by-step digital guidance for picking, packing, and loading tasks, these technologies help reduce mistakes, support workforce training, and boost operational efficiency."}),"
",n(a.h2,{id:"logistics-demands-are-risingand-so-are-the-risks-of-error",children:["Logistics demands are rising—and so are the risks of error",i(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#logistics-demands-are-risingand-so-are-the-risks-of-error",children:i(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(a.p,{children:"The logistics sector is under pressure from all directions. E-commerce growth, just-in-time supply chains, and increasing product variety are raising the stakes for warehouses, distribution centers, and transportation hubs. At the same time, skilled labor shortages and high staff turnover make it harder to maintain quality and consistency."}),"
",i(a.p,{children:"Common pain points for logistics leaders include:"}),"
",n(a.ul,{children:["
",i(a.li,{children:"High picking error rates leading to customer complaints and costly returns"}),"
",i(a.li,{children:"Packing mistakes that cause product damage or shipment delays"}),"
",i(a.li,{children:"Loading errors resulting in inefficient use of space or safety hazards"}),"
",i(a.li,{children:"Difficulty onboarding new technicians quickly and consistently"}),"
",i(a.li,{children:"Manual, paper-based SOPs that are ignored or out of date"}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:["According to the ",i(a.a,{href:"https://www.logisticsbureau.com/logistics-mistakes/",children:"Logistics Bureau"}),", picking errors alone can cost companies up to $50 per error, not counting the impact on customer satisfaction and brand reputation."]}),"
",i(a.p,{children:"These challenges are not just operational headaches—they directly affect the bottom line, regulatory compliance, and workforce morale. For many logistics operations, reducing mistakes is now a board-level priority."}),"
",n(a.h2,{id:"why-change-is-urgent-compliance-complexity-and-workforce-shifts",children:["Why change is urgent: compliance, complexity, and workforce shifts",i(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#why-change-is-urgent-compliance-complexity-and-workforce-shifts",children:i(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(a.p,{children:"Today's logistics environment is more complex than ever. Regulations around product traceability, load securing, and worker safety continue to tighten. At the same time, warehouses are handling a broader range of SKUs, with frequent changeovers and custom orders."}),"
",i(a.p,{children:"Three factors are driving the need for smarter, digital work instructions:"}),"
",n(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:[i(a.strong,{children:"Increasing complexity"}),": More SKUs, custom packaging, and mixed-load shipments make traditional paper SOPs inadequate."]}),"
",n(a.li,{children:[i(a.strong,{children:"Skills gap"}),": High turnover and seasonal surges mean many team members are inexperienced or unfamiliar with current procedures."]}),"
",n(a.li,{children:[i(a.strong,{children:"Compliance and safety"}),": Regulations require documented, auditable processes for handling hazardous goods, food products, or pharmaceuticals."]}),"
"]}),"

",n(t.li,{children:"Data from each audit feeds into predictive maintenance systems."}),"

",n(t.li,{children:"30–60% faster onboarding of new technicians for audit tasks."}),"

",n(t.li,{children:"Zero missed allergen cleaning steps—down from an average of 2–3 per audit."}),"

title: Building a digital library of work and safety instructions that people actually use
description: Build a digital library of work and safety instructions that teams actually use. For operations, HSE, and training leaders in industry: practical steps, use cases, and ROI.

author: ActARion
body:
const{Fragment:e,jsx:n,jsxs:i}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(a){const t={a:"a",blockquote:"blockquote",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",li:"li",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...a.components};return i(e,{children:[i(t.h1,{id:"building-a-digital-library-of-work-and-safety-instructions-that-people-actually-use",children:["Building a digital library of work and safety instructions that people actually use",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#building-a-digital-library-of-work-and-safety-instructions-that-people-actually-use",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"A digital library of work and safety instructions can transform how teams in industrial environments work—if people actually use it. Too often, digital SOPs and safety documents are created but left untouched, buried in shared drives or complicated platforms. The real challenge is building a digital library that is accessible, relevant, and trusted by technicians, operators, and field engineers. For operations, HSE, and training leaders, the goal is clear: make every critical instruction available at the point of need, in a format teams will rely on."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"why-most-digital-libraries-fail-to-deliver-value",children:["Why most digital libraries fail to deliver value",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#why-most-digital-libraries-fail-to-deliver-value",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Many organisations invest in digital work instructions and AR SOPs, but the results often fall short. Content gets outdated, navigation is confusing, and usage rates are low. This is not just an IT issue; it affects productivity, safety, and compliance."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Common reasons digital libraries underperform:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Instructions are too generic, hard to find, or not tailored to real tasks."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Teams lack confidence in the accuracy or relevance of the content."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Updates are slow, and version control is weak."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Access is limited to desktops or requires cumbersome logins."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"No feedback loop for teams to suggest improvements or report errors."}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.p,{children:["A 2023 survey from the ",n(t.a,{href:"https://www.nsc.org/workplace/safety-topics/safety-technology",children:"National Safety Council"}),' found that 62% of industrial safety managers cite "out-of-date or hard-to-access procedures" as a top operational risk. When work instructions aren't used, incidents increase, onboarding drags out, and process quality declines.']}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"why-now-skills-gaps-safety-demands-and-operational-pressure",children:["Why now: Skills gaps, safety demands, and operational pressure",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#why-now-skills-gaps-safety-demands-and-operational-pressure",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Industrial organisations are facing a convergence of challenges:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Skills gaps are widening as experienced technicians retire."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Regulatory and client demands for traceable compliance are rising."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Production targets are tighter, with little room for error."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Teams are more mobile, with work happening across plants, sites, and shifts."}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Traditional paper manuals and static PDFs cannot keep up with these needs. Teams require up-to-date, searchable, and context-aware instructions—available where the work happens. Digital libraries must deliver guidance on any device, support rapid updates, and provide usage data to drive continuous improvement."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"how-ai-and-arguided-work-instructions-drive-adoption",children:["How AI and AR–guided work instructions drive adoption",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#how-ai-and-arguided-work-instructions-drive-adoption",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"The key to a successful digital library is not just digitising content, but making it actionable and easy to use. AI and AR–guided work instructions change the game by delivering information in context, on the job, and in the right format."}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"what-makes-instructions-usable-in-the-field",children:['What makes instructions "usable" in the field',n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#what-makes-instructions-usable-in-the-field",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Usable work and safety instructions share several characteristics:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Searchable and filterable:"})," Teams can quickly find the right SOP or safety checklist by asset, task, or risk."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Step-by-step guidance:"})," Clear, concise steps, supported by visuals or AR overlays, reduce ambiguity."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Device-agnostic access:"})," Instructions are available on tablets, smartphones, AR glasses, or desktop."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Always up to date:"})," Automated version control and instant publishing of approved changes."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Feedback-enabled:"})," Teams can flag unclear steps and suggest improvements directly within the workflow."]}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"By embedding AI, digital libraries can recommend relevant instructions based on context—such as job role, location, or equipment. AR adds another layer by presenting steps visually, guiding technicians through complex procedures hands-free."}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"example-ar-sops-in-equipment-maintenance",children:["Example: AR SOPs in equipment maintenance",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#example-ar-sops-in-equipment-maintenance",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Consider a maintenance lead overseeing rotating equipment. With AI and AR–guided work instructions, technicians scan a QR code at the machine, instantly pulling up the latest SOP. AR overlays show where to inspect, what to check, and alert if steps are skipped. If a procedure changes, updates push automatically to all users. The result: less downtime, fewer errors, and a clear audit trail."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"building-a-digital-library-that-teams-trust-and-use",children:["Building a digital library that teams trust and use",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#building-a-digital-library-that-teams-trust-and-use",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"To create a digital library that drives real value, leaders must focus on adoption, governance, and continuous improvement—not just content digitisation."}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"step-1-map-critical-work-and-safety-processes",children:["Step 1: Map critical work and safety processes",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#step-1-map-critical-work-and-safety-processes",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Start by identifying the highest-impact procedures—those tied to safety, compliance, or frequent downtime. Prioritise:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Lockout/tagout procedures"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Confined space entry"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Preventive maintenance tasks"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Changeover routines"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Emergency response protocols"}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Work with experienced technicians and HSE experts to capture tacit knowledge that often never makes it into manuals."}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"step-2-design-for-usability-and-accessibility",children:["Step 2: Design for usability and accessibility",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#step-2-design-for-usability-and-accessibility",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Content must be structured for fast access and field use. Best practices include:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Use plain language and avoid jargon."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Break instructions into clear, numbered steps."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Add photos, diagrams, or AR cues to clarify actions."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Tag procedures by equipment, location, risk level, and user role."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Optimise for mobile and hands-free devices."}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.p,{children:["A 2022 ",n(t.a,{href:"https://www2.deloitte.com/us/en/insights/focus/industry-4-0/digital-transformation-in-manufacturing.html",children:"Deloitte report"})," highlights that digital work instructions improve first-time-right rates by up to 25% when designed for field usability."]}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"step-3-enable-rapid-updates-and-strong-governance",children:["Step 3: Enable rapid updates and strong governance",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#step-3-enable-rapid-updates-and-strong-governance",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Outdated or conflicting instructions erode trust. Establish clear ownership for content review and approval:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Assign process owners for each SOP or safety document."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Use digital workflows for drafting, review, and publishing."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Track version history and ensure only the latest instructions are accessible."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Schedule regular audits to remove obsolete content."}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Integrating with asset management or EHS platforms can automate triggers for instruction updates when equipment or regulations change."}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"step-4-close-the-feedback-loop-with-teams",children:["Step 4: Close the feedback loop with teams",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#step-4-close-the-feedback-loop-with-teams",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Encourage technicians and operators to report unclear steps, missing information, or improvement ideas. Digital libraries should:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Allow in-context feedback submissions."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Route suggestions to process owners for review."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Share updates or clarifications with all users."}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"This not only improves content quality but also drives engagement and a sense of ownership."}),"

",n(a.p,{children:"Selecting the right hardware for AR on the job—smart glasses, tablets, or smartphones—directly impacts productivity, safety, and quality in industrial environments. As AR and AI–guided work instructions become standard in maintenance, inspections, training, and safety, operations leaders face a critical decision: which device delivers the best results for their teams and processes?"}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"ar-hardware-options-are-multiplyingand-so-are-the-choices",children:["AR hardware options are multiplying—and so are the choices",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#ar-hardware-options-are-multiplyingand-so-are-the-choices",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Industrial companies are moving quickly to digitize processes and introduce AR–guided work instructions. The hardware landscape, however, is complex. Smart glasses promise hands-free operation. Tablets offer larger screens and flexibility. Smartphones are everywhere and familiar. Each device has strengths and trade-offs."}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Choosing the right AR hardware is not about following trends or picking the latest gadget. It is about matching device capabilities to your environment, task requirements, safety standards, and workforce needs."}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"the-case-for-change-why-hardware-choice-matters-now",children:["The case for change: why hardware choice matters now",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#the-case-for-change-why-hardware-choice-matters-now",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Industrial sectors are under pressure to boost efficiency, reduce errors, and upskill teams—often with fewer resources and tighter compliance demands. Traditional paper SOPs and manual training are too slow and error-prone for today’s pace."}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Digital work instructions, delivered through AR and AI, help address these challenges by:"}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"Standardizing procedures across shifts and sites"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Enabling real-time guidance and remote support"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Reducing onboarding time and skill gaps"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Improving data capture for compliance and audits"}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"But the impact of digital instructions depends on how teams access and interact with them. Hardware that is awkward, unsafe, or ill-suited to the environment can undermine even the best AR content."}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Recent research from PwC and the Fraunhofer Institute highlights that device usability and task fit significantly affect both safety and productivity in industrial AR deployments (PwC, 2023; Fraunhofer, 2022)."}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"key-requirements-for-ar-hardware-in-industrial-environments",children:["Key requirements for AR hardware in industrial environments",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#key-requirements-for-ar-hardware-in-industrial-environments",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Before comparing devices, clarify what matters most for your use case. For most industrial operations, the following requirements are critical:"}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Safety and compliance:"})," Devices must not create hazards. ATEX or IECEx certification may be required in explosive environments."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Hands-free operation:"})," Essential for many maintenance, inspection, and assembly tasks."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Durability:"})," Devices must withstand dust, moisture, drops, and temperature extremes."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Battery life:"})," Sufficient for a full shift, especially for field engineers and remote sites."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Ease of use:"})," Minimal training required; intuitive interfaces are essential for adoption."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Connectivity:"})," Reliable Wi-Fi, LTE, or 5G for real-time AR content and remote support."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Integration:"})," Compatibility with existing systems (CMMS, LMS, EHS platforms)."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Data security:"})," Compliance with corporate IT and data protection policies."]}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"comparing-ar-hardware-smart-glasses-tablets-and-smartphones",children:["Comparing AR hardware: smart glasses, tablets, and smartphones",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#comparing-ar-hardware-smart-glasses-tablets-and-smartphones",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Each hardware option brings distinct advantages and limitations. The best choice depends on your workflows, environments, and priorities."}),"
",i(a.h3,{id:"smart-glasses-hands-free-but-with-caveats",children:["Smart glasses: hands-free, but with caveats",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#smart-glasses-hands-free-but-with-caveats",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:n(a.strong,{children:"Strengths:"})}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"True hands-free operation—critical for tasks that require both hands (e.g., electrical work, assembly, climbing ladders)."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Heads-up display overlays AR instructions directly in the field of view."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Voice or gesture controls reduce need for physical interaction."}),"

"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:n(a.strong,{children:"Best for:"})}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"Maintenance, inspection, or repair tasks where hands-free is mandatory."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Environments where safety or hygiene prohibits hand-held devices."}),"
",i(a.li,{children:["Remote expert support (see ",n(a.a,{href:"/use-cases/remote-support",children:"remote support for field engineers"}),")."]}),"
"]}),"

",n(a.p,{children:n(a.strong,{children:"Best for:"})}),"

",n(a.li,{children:"Data capture (photos, voice notes) in inspections or audits."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Environments where tablets or glasses are impractical."}),"

",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Smartphones"})," provide quick reference for SOPs or to document issues."]}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.h3,{id:"operator-training-and-onboarding",children:["Operator training and onboarding",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#operator-training-and-onboarding",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Tablets"})," support interactive, group-based AR training and onboarding for new technicians (",n(a.a,{href:"/use-cases/ar-onboarding",children:"AR onboarding for technicians"}),")."]}),"

The stakes are high: inconsistent skills can mean safety incidents, lost productivity, and regulatory risk."}),"
",e(a.p,{children:"At the same time, digital transformation is changing expectations for workforce readiness. Teams are expected to adapt quickly to new equipment, procedures, and compliance requirements. The cost of errors or delays continues to rise."}),"
",e(a.p,{children:"Yet many organizations struggle to modernize their learning journey. Common hurdles include:"}),"

author: ActARion
body:
const{Fragment:e,jsx:n,jsxs:r}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(i){const a={a:"a",em:"em",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",li:"li",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...i.components};return r(e,{children:[r(a.h1,{id:"error-free-assembly-with-ar-reducing-rework-and-scrap-in-complex-production",children:["Error free assembly with AR: reducing rework and scrap in complex production",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#error-free-assembly-with-ar-reducing-rework-and-scrap-in-complex-production",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Assembly errors drive up costs and risk in complex manufacturing. High-value sectors—such as aerospace, automotive, electronics, and industrial equipment—face pressure to deliver flawless products, on time and within budget. Yet, even experienced teams struggle to eliminate mistakes during intricate assembly tasks. As product complexity grows, so do risks of rework, scrap, and quality escapes."}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"AI and AR–guided work instructions now offer a concrete path to error free assembly. By digitizing and visualizing each step, these technologies help technicians work smarter, safer, and faster—cutting rework and scrap in even the most demanding production environments."}),"
",r(a.h2,{id:"complex-assembly-where-errors-start-and-why-they-multiply",children:["Complex assembly: where errors start and why they multiply",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#complex-assembly-where-errors-start-and-why-they-multiply",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Assembly operations in advanced manufacturing are never simple. Components are diverse, tolerances are tight, and the sequence of operations is critical. Small mistakes—misaligned parts, missed fasteners, or incorrect torque—can cascade into expensive failures."}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Key drivers of error and waste in complex assembly include:"}),"
",r(a.ul,{children:["
",r(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Manual process variation:"})," Even skilled technicians interpret paper SOPs differently, leading to inconsistent results."]}),"
",r(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Change management gaps:"})," Engineering changes, updated work instructions, or new materials are not always communicated or adopted in real time."]}),"
",r(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Training limitations:"})," Ramp-up for new hires or transfers is slow, and tribal knowledge is hard to transfer."]}),"
",r(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Verification bottlenecks:"})," Manual checks are prone to oversight and do not always catch subtle deviations."]}),"
"]}),"
",r(a.p,{children:["These pain points are well documented. The ",n(a.em,{children:"International Journal of Advanced Manufacturing Technology"})," found that human error accounts for over 20% of assembly-related defects in high-mix, low-volume production (",n(a.a,{href:"https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s00170-018-2021-6",children:"source"}),"). For every error detected late, the cost to rework or scrap the assembly rises exponentially."]}),"
",r(a.h2,{id:"why-traditional-approaches-fall-short-in-todays-production",children:["Why traditional approaches fall short in today’s production",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#why-traditional-approaches-fall-short-in-todays-production",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Most manufacturers rely on a mix of paper SOPs, static digital documents, and peer-to-peer training. While these methods are familiar, they have clear limitations:"}),"
",r(a.ul,{children:["
",r(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Paper-based SOPs:"})," Prone to wear, misplacement, and misinterpretation. Updates are slow and adoption is inconsistent."]}),"
",r(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Digital PDFs and checklists:"})," Reduce some errors, but lack contextual guidance and real-time feedback."]}),"
",r(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Shadowing and mentoring:"})," Useful for onboarding, but hard to scale and dependent on individual trainers."]}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"For decision makers, the result is persistent rework rates (often 5–10% in complex lines), unpredictable scrap, and high costs for quality assurance. As product variants multiply and regulatory demands tighten, these legacy approaches cannot keep up."}),"
",r(a.h2,{id:"how-ai-and-arguided-work-instructions-enable-error-free-assembly",children:["How AI and AR–guided work instructions enable error free assembly",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#how-ai-and-arguided-work-instructions-enable-error-free-assembly",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"AI and AR–guided work instructions tackle the root causes of assembly errors by making procedures digital, interactive, and context-aware. Here’s how:"}),"
",r(a.h3,{id:"visualizing-each-step-eliminating-ambiguity",children:["Visualizing each step, eliminating ambiguity",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#visualizing-each-step-eliminating-ambiguity",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"With AR SOPs, technicians see work instructions overlaid directly onto the physical workspace—via smart glasses or tablets. Instead of flipping through manuals, they follow clear, visual cues showing:"}),"
",r(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"Exact part placement and orientation"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Correct tool selection and usage"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Real-time prompts for torque, sequencing, and inspection points"}),"

const{Fragment:n,jsx:e,jsxs:i}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(a){const t={a:"a",blockquote:"blockquote",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",li:"li",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...a.components};return i(n,{children:[i(t.h1,{id:"how-ai-can-turn-photos-and-videos-into-multilingual-work-instructions",children:["How AI can turn photos and videos into multilingual work instructions",e(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#how-ai-can-turn-photos-and-videos-into-multilingual-work-instructions",children:e(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",e(t.p,{children:"Modern industrial operations face a persistent challenge: ensuring every technician, operator, and field engineer has access to clear, accurate, and up-to-date work instructions—no matter their language or location. As teams grow more diverse and tasks become more complex, traditional text-based manuals and static PDFs fall short. AI-powered solutions now make it possible to convert everyday photos and videos directly into multilingual, step-by-step digital work instructions, transforming the way technical knowledge is captured, shared, and executed."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"why-industrial-teams-need-better-work-instructions-now",children:["Why industrial teams need better work instructions now",e(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#why-industrial-teams-need-better-work-instructions-now",children:e(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",e(t.p,{children:"Operations managers, HSE leaders, and training professionals know that safe and efficient work depends on clear instructions. Yet, many still rely on outdated documentation or informal “shadowing,” which leads to:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",e(t.li,{children:"Inconsistent task execution and increased error rates"}),"

",e(t.li,{children:"Gaps in compliance, traceability, and audit readiness"}),"
",e(t.li,{children:"Language barriers within multinational teams"}),"
"]}),"
",e(t.p,{children:"The industrial workforce is changing. According to the European Agency for Safety and Health at Work, language barriers are a top contributor to accidents among migrant workers in manufacturing and construction (EU-OSHA, 2021). Meanwhile, high turnover and the retirement of experienced staff create a “knowledge drain” that cannot be filled by PDFs or static SOPs alone."}),"
",e(t.p,{children:"The need to digitize, standardize, and localize work instructions is urgent—especially for organizations aiming to boost productivity, reduce downtime, and meet stringent safety and quality standards."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"the-limitations-of-traditional-documentation-and-manual-translation",children:["The limitations of traditional documentation and manual translation",e(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#the-limitations-of-traditional-documentation-and-manual-translation",children:e(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",e(t.p,{children:"Legacy documentation methods struggle to keep up with today’s pace of change:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",e(t.li,{children:"Paper manuals and PDFs are hard to update, distribute, and track."}),"
",e(t.li,{children:"Video tutorials are useful, but difficult to search, translate, or break down into actionable steps."}),"
",e(t.li,{children:"Manual translation processes are slow, costly, and error-prone, often missing technical nuance."}),"
",e(t.li,{children:"Informal knowledge transfer (“watch me do it once”) is inconsistent and leaves no audit trail."}),"
"]}),"
",e(t.p,{children:"These gaps lead to lost productivity, safety incidents, and compliance risks. Multinational teams, in particular, face extra hurdles when work instructions are only available in one language or lack visual context."}),"

const{Fragment:e,jsx:n,jsxs:i}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(r){const a={a:"a",blockquote:"blockquote",em:"em",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",h4:"h4",li:"li",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...r.components};return i(e,{children:[i(a.h1,{id:"how-to-measure-the-roi-of-ar-and-ai-guided-work-instructions",children:["How to measure the ROI of AR and AI guided work instructions",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#how-to-measure-the-roi-of-ar-and-ai-guided-work-instructions",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Understanding the return on investment (ROI) for AR and AI guided work instructions is a top priority for operations managers, HSE leaders, maintenance heads, and L&D professionals in industrial environments. With budgets under scrutiny and safety, productivity, and workforce readiness at stake, decision makers need clear methods to justify investments in digital work instructions. This guide provides a practical framework for measuring ROI, using real-world examples and proven metrics."}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"why-measuring-roi-for-digital-work-instructions-matters-now",children:["Why measuring ROI for digital work instructions matters now",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#why-measuring-roi-for-digital-work-instructions-matters-now",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Industrial companies face relentless pressure to improve uptime, ensure compliance, reduce incidents, and retain skilled technicians. Traditional paper-based standard operating procedures (SOPs) and manual training methods are often slow, error-prone, and hard to update. As a result, organizations risk:"}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"Increased downtime due to mistakes and rework"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Safety incidents stemming from skipped steps or unclear procedures"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Longer onboarding times for new technicians"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Inconsistent quality and audit gaps"}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"The move to AR and AI–guided work instructions is accelerating, driven by the need for real-time, standardized, and easily updated procedures. Yet, many leaders hesitate to invest without clear evidence of financial and operational returns. Understanding ROI is no longer optional—it is essential for justifying change and ensuring sustained impact."}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"what-makes-roi-measurement-challenging-in-industrial-settings",children:["What makes ROI measurement challenging in industrial settings",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#what-makes-roi-measurement-challenging-in-industrial-settings",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Unlike software with simple license metrics, AR and AI guided work instructions impact a complex mix of tangible and intangible factors. Key challenges include:"}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Defining baseline performance:"})," Many teams lack detailed historical data on error rates, training times, or rework."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Quantifying “soft” benefits:"})," Improvements in knowledge retention, safety culture, or employee confidence can be hard to express in financial terms."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Attribution:"})," When multiple improvement projects run in parallel, isolating the impact of digital work instructions is complex."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Hardware and integration costs:"})," Upfront investments in AR devices and system integration must be included, not just software costs."]}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Despite these challenges, a growing body of case studies and proven frameworks make ROI measurement both feasible and credible."}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"the-core-roi-framework-for-ar-and-ai-guided-work-instructions",children:["The core ROI framework for AR and AI guided work instructions",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#the-core-roi-framework-for-ar-and-ai-guided-work-instructions",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"A robust ROI calculation for digital work instructions in industrial settings should cover both direct and indirect benefits. The most common approach includes:"}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Productivity gains:"})," Faster task completion, reduced downtime, and increased throughput."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Quality improvements:"})," Fewer errors, less rework, and more consistent adherence to SOPs."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Safety outcomes:"})," Lower incident rates, near-miss reductions, and improved compliance."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Training efficiency:"})," Shorter onboarding, faster upskilling, and lower training costs."]}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"The basic formula:"}),"
",n(a.p,{children:n(a.strong,{children:"ROI (%) = (Total Annual Benefit – Total Annual Cost) / Total Annual Cost × 100"})}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Where:"}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.em,{children:"Total Annual Benefit"})," = sum of all measured gains (savings, avoided costs, productivity increases)"]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.em,{children:"Total Annual Cost"})," = software, hardware, integration, content creation, and training"]}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.h3,{id:"key-roi-metrics-for-ar-and-ai-guided-work-instructions",children:["Key ROI metrics for AR and AI guided work instructions",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#key-roi-metrics-for-ar-and-ai-guided-work-instructions",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"

",n(a.li,{children:"Cost per training hour delivered"}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"how-ar-and-ai-guided-work-instructions-deliver-measurable-value",children:["How AR and AI guided work instructions deliver measurable value",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#how-ar-and-ai-guided-work-instructions-deliver-measurable-value",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"AR SOPs and AI-powered digital work instructions provide real-time, step-by-step guidance through headsets, tablets, or mobile devices. This approach standardizes execution and provides instant access to visual references, automated checks, and contextual information."}),"
",i(a.h3,{id:"typical-use-cases-and-outcomes",children:["Typical use cases and outcomes",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#typical-use-cases-and-outcomes",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(a.h4,{id:"1-maintenance-and-equipment-inspections",children:["1. Maintenance and equipment inspections",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#1-maintenance-and-equipment-inspections",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"

"]}),"
",i(a.h4,{id:"4-quality-and-audit-readiness",children:["4. Quality and audit readiness",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#4-quality-and-audit-readiness",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"

",n(a.p,{children:"Introducing AR devices raises questions about ruggedness, battery life, and IT integration. However, budget for device procurement, support, and periodic upgrades should be included in ROI calculations."}),"

title: Remote expert support with AR: resolving downtime without flying in specialists
description: Discover how remote expert support with AR enables industrial teams to resolve downtime faster, maintain quality, and reduce costs without flying in specialists.

image.alt: Remote expert support with AR: resolving downtime without flying in specialists

author: ActARion
body:
const{Fragment:e,jsx:n,jsxs:i}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(t){const r={a:"a",blockquote:"blockquote",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",li:"li",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...t.components};return i(e,{children:[i(r.h1,{id:"remote-expert-support-with-ar-resolving-downtime-without-flying-in-specialists",children:["Remote expert support with AR: resolving downtime without flying in specialists",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#remote-expert-support-with-ar-resolving-downtime-without-flying-in-specialists",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Unplanned downtime is a critical challenge for industrial operations. When systems fail or complex maintenance is required, the fastest path to resolution often means bringing in an external specialist—at significant cost, delay, and risk to productivity. Remote expert support with AR (augmented reality) is changing that equation. By enabling real-time, on-site guidance from experts anywhere in the world, AI and AR–guided work instructions help your teams resolve downtime faster, maintain quality and safety, and avoid the need to fly in specialists."}),"
",i(r.h2,{id:"downtime-and-specialist-dependence-why-change-is-urgent",children:["Downtime and specialist dependence: why change is urgent",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#downtime-and-specialist-dependence-why-change-is-urgent",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Industrial sites—whether manufacturing plants, energy facilities, or logistics hubs—rely on the smooth, uninterrupted operation of complex equipment. When something goes wrong, the consequences are immediate:"}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",n(r.li,{children:"Production lines stop, causing loss of output and revenue."}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"Safety risks increase, especially when unfamiliar teams attempt urgent repairs."}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"Compliance and quality can be compromised if unqualified interventions are made."}),"
"]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Traditionally, the solution has been to call in a vendor or technical specialist. According to a 2023 ARC Advisory Group report, unplanned downtime costs manufacturers an estimated $50 billion per year globally, with up to 42% of incidents requiring external intervention. Travel delays, visa processes, and specialist availability can easily stretch downtime from hours to days."}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"This approach is increasingly unsustainable:"}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",n(r.li,{children:"Rising travel costs and supply chain disruptions make flying in experts more expensive and less reliable."}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"Skills shortages mean fewer specialists are available, especially for legacy or bespoke equipment."}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"Environmental and ESG goals push companies to minimize unnecessary travel."}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"Teams need to upskill and become more self-reliant to maintain uptime and safety."}),"
"]}),"
",i(r.h2,{id:"the-gap-why-on-site-teams-struggle-with-complex-issues",children:["The gap: why on-site teams struggle with complex issues",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#the-gap-why-on-site-teams-struggle-with-complex-issues",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Even with strong in-house maintenance and operations teams, several barriers prevent rapid resolution of complex problems:"}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",n(r.li,{children:"OEM manuals and SOPs are often static, generic, and hard to follow under pressure."}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"Knowledge transfer is inconsistent, especially with staff turnover and retirements."}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"Remote support calls via phone or video lack the context and clarity needed for precise troubleshooting."}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"Language barriers and miscommunication lead to errors and rework."}),"
"]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"For decision makers, the result is a difficult trade-off: accept costly downtime, or accept the risks of incomplete or incorrect repairs."}),"
",i(r.h2,{id:"how-remote-expert-support-with-ar-works",children:["How remote expert support with AR works",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#how-remote-expert-support-with-ar-works",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Remote expert support with AR bridges these gaps by combining live, real-time communication with digital overlays, step-by-step AR SOPs, and AI-powered guidance. Here’s how it works in practice:"}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",n(r.li,{children:"On-site technicians use AR-enabled devices (smart glasses, tablets, or phones) to connect with remote experts."}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"The expert sees exactly what the technician sees, in real time, through a secure video feed."}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"Using AR, the expert can annotate the technician’s field of view—highlighting components, drawing arrows, or overlaying instructions directly onto the equipment."}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"AI and AR–guided work instructions provide relevant SOPs, checklists, and troubleshooting steps, customized for the specific asset and scenario."}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"Documentation and session recording ensure compliance and knowledge capture for future reference."}),"

const{Fragment:e,jsx:n,jsxs:r}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(i){const a={a:"a",blockquote:"blockquote",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",li:"li",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...i.components};return r(e,{children:[r(a.h1,{id:"using-ar-work-instructions-to-standardise-rare-or-high-risk-procedures",children:["Using AR work instructions to standardise rare or high risk procedures",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#using-ar-work-instructions-to-standardise-rare-or-high-risk-procedures",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Industrial teams regularly face procedures that, while rare, carry significant risk. Complex changeovers, emergency shutdowns, confined space entries, and critical maintenance tasks demand absolute precision. Yet, because these procedures are performed infrequently, even experienced technicians and operators can struggle to recall exact steps, increasing the risk of errors, incidents, and downtime."}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Augmented reality (AR) work instructions offer a practical, proven way to standardise these rare or high risk procedures—making work safer, more consistent, and easier to audit."}),"
",r(a.h2,{id:"why-rare-and-high-risk-procedures-remain-a-challenge",children:["Why rare and high risk procedures remain a challenge",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#why-rare-and-high-risk-procedures-remain-a-challenge",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Most industrial sites have robust standard operating procedures (SOPs) for daily tasks. But rare or high risk procedures create unique challenges:"}),"
",r(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"Technicians may not have repeated exposure to the steps, so memory fades."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Paper-based SOPs can be overlooked, misinterpreted, or outdated."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Verbal handovers lose detail, especially across shifts or teams."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"High risk tasks often require rapid, correct action under pressure."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Auditors and safety leads need clear evidence of compliance and training."}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"For example, a chemical plant may only perform a full vessel decontamination once a year. A water utility might only isolate major pipelines during emergency repairs. In these cases, a single mistake can lead to injuries, environmental incidents, or costly downtime."}),"
",r(a.p,{children:["Research from the Institution of Chemical Engineers (IChemE) highlights that rare procedures are disproportionately represented in incident reports, largely due to lapses in memory, unclear instructions, or incomplete handovers (",n(a.a,{href:"https://www.icheme.org/",children:"IChemE, 2020"}),")."]}),"
",r(a.h2,{id:"why-now-regulatory-and-workforce-trends-increase-the-need-for-standardisation",children:["Why now: regulatory and workforce trends increase the need for standardisation",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#why-now-regulatory-and-workforce-trends-increase-the-need-for-standardisation",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Several trends are converging to make standardisation of rare and high risk procedures a top priority:"}),"
",r(a.ul,{children:["
",r(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Stricter regulatory requirements"})," for evidence-based training and procedural compliance."]}),"
",r(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Aging workforce"})," and increased turnover, leading to loss of institutional knowledge."]}),"
",r(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"More complex equipment"})," and interconnected systems, raising the stakes for error."]}),"
",r(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Digital transformation"})," mandates, requiring traceable, auditable processes."]}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"For operations managers, HSE leads, and training professionals, relying on static documents or informal coaching is no longer enough. Digital solutions that deliver guidance at the point of work—and capture proof of execution—are now essential for operational excellence."}),"
",r(a.h2,{id:"how-ar-work-instructions-support-safer-more-consistent-execution",children:["How AR work instructions support safer, more consistent execution",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#how-ar-work-instructions-support-safer-more-consistent-execution",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"AR work instructions combine visual, step-by-step guidance with real-time data and context. Delivered via smart glasses, tablets, or mobile devices, they overlay digital instructions onto the physical workspace, making each step clear and unambiguous."}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Key features include:"}),"
",r(a.ul,{children:["
",r(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Visual overlays:"})," Diagrams, animations, and markers that show exactly where to act."]}),"
",r(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Interactive checklists:"})," Require confirmation or input before proceeding."]}),"
",r(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Embedded reference materials:"})," Safety data sheets, equipment manuals, or video clips."]}),"
",r(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Contextual prompts:"})," Adapt instructions based on sensor data or operator input."]}),"
",r(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Automated documentation:"})," Capture time-stamped records, photos, and digital sign-offs."]}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"This approach addresses the core risks of rare or high risk procedures:"}),"
",r(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"Reduces reliance on memory or paper."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Ensures critical steps are not skipped or performed out of sequence."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Supports less experienced team members with just-in-time knowledge."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Provides real-time support for troubleshooting or escalation."}),"
"]}),"
",r(a.blockquote,{children:["
",r(a.p,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Note:"})," A 2022 study by the Fraunhofer Institute found that AR-guided procedures reduced error rates by 40% and improved procedural compliance by over 30% in pharmaceutical and chemical manufacturing."]}),"
"]}),"
",r(a.h2,{id:"use-cases-where-ar-sops-make-the-biggest-impact",children:["Use cases: where AR SOPs make the biggest impact",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#use-cases-where-ar-sops-make-the-biggest-impact",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"AR work instructions are particularly valuable for procedures where the stakes are high and repetition is low. Common industrial use cases include:"}),"
",r(a.h3,{id:"emergency-shutdowns-and-lockouttagout-loto",children:["Emergency shutdowns and lockout/tagout (LOTO)",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#emergency-shutdowns-and-lockouttagout-loto",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"When a line or facility must be safely powered down, every step matters. AR SOPs guide technicians through the correct sequence, confirm each isolation point, and record proof of execution—minimising the risk of accidental energisation."}),"
",r(a.h3,{id:"confined-space-entries",children:["Confined space entries",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#confined-space-entries",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"AR-guided checklists ensure all pre-entry safety checks, atmospheric tests, and permit requirements are completed and documented before anyone enters a vessel or tank. Visual overlays help identify access points and hazards."}),"
",r(a.h3,{id:"critical-maintenance-and-calibrations",children:["Critical maintenance and calibrations",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#critical-maintenance-and-calibrations",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"For tasks like pressure relief valve replacement or instrument calibration, AR SOPs show the correct tools, torque values, and sequence—reducing the risk of leaks, contamination, or misalignment."}),"
",r(a.h3,{id:"complex-changeovers-and-commissioning",children:["Complex changeovers and commissioning",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#complex-changeovers-and-commissioning",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"During product changeovers or equipment commissioning, AR work instructions help teams avoid cross-contamination, missed cleaning steps, or configuration errors, especially when procedures are infrequent."}),"
",r(a.h3,{id:"incident-response-and-troubleshooting",children:["Incident response and troubleshooting",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#incident-response-and-troubleshooting",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"AR SOPs can provide immediate, step-by-step guidance during fire alarms, chemical spills, or equipment failures—helping operators respond correctly while capturing an audit trail for later review."}),"
",r(a.h2,{id:"results-measurable-improvements-in-safety-quality-and-training",children:["Results: measurable improvements in safety, quality, and training",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#results-measurable-improvements-in-safety-quality-and-training",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Industrial companies using AR work instructions for rare or high risk procedures report concrete benefits:"}),"
",r(a.ul,{children:["
",r(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Fewer incidents:"})," Lower rates of procedural errors and near-misses."]}),"
",r(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Improved compliance:"})," Digital records for audits and regulatory reporting."]}),"
",r(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Faster onboarding:"})," New technicians become competent in complex tasks more quickly."]}),"
",r(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Reduced downtime:"})," Quicker, more reliable execution of critical tasks."]}),"
",r(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Increased workforce confidence:"})," Teams feel supported when tackling unfamiliar or stressful procedures."]}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"A leading energy utility implemented AR SOPs for annual transformer maintenance. The result: 100% procedural compliance, zero incidents, and a 25% reduction in task duration compared to previous years."}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Similarly, a pharmaceutical packaging site used AR-guided work instructions for rare line changeovers, reducing deviation reports by 60% and cutting changeover time by 15%."}),"
",r(a.h2,{id:"what-actarion-brings-to-standardising-rare-or-high-risk-procedures",children:["What ActARion brings to standardising rare or high risk procedures",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#what-actarion-brings-to-standardising-rare-or-high-risk-procedures",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"ActARion works with industrial companies to digitise and deploy AR SOPs for critical procedures. Our approach focuses on:"}),"
",r(a.ul,{children:["
",r(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Process mapping:"})," Collaborate with your SMEs to capture every step, risk, and control."]}),"
",r(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Content creation:"})," Develop clear, visual instructions tailored to your equipment and environment."]}),"
",r(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Device selection:"})," Advise on the right hardware—smart glasses, tablets, or mobile—based on your safety and operational needs."]}),"
",r(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Change management:"})," Support stakeholder engagement, training, and governance."]}),"
",r(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Integration:"})," Connect AR SOPs with your EHS, CMMS, or training systems for seamless documentation."]}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"We prioritise measurable ROI: fewer incidents, higher audit scores, reduced downtime, and faster workforce readiness. Our platform is designed for easy updates as procedures evolve, ensuring your teams always have the latest, verified guidance at hand."}),"
",r(a.h2,{id:"addressing-practical-concerns-hardware-adoption-and-content",children:["Addressing practical concerns: hardware, adoption, and content",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#addressing-practical-concerns-hardware-adoption-and-content",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Implementing AR work instructions for rare or high risk procedures raises valid questions:"}),"
",r(a.ul,{children:["
",r(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Hardware compatibility:"})," Modern AR platforms support a range of intrinsically safe devices for hazardous environments. We help you select and pilot the right option."]}),"
",r(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"User adoption:"})," Initial training is essential. Our experience shows most technicians adapt quickly, especially when instructions are clear and the benefits are evident."]}),"
",r(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Content creation:"})," Digitising rare procedures requires collaboration with your SMEs. We provide templates, workshops, and support to accelerate the process."]}),"
",r(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Governance:"})," Version control, access permissions, and audit trails are built in. You control who can view, execute, or update each procedure."]}),"
"]}),"
",r(a.blockquote,{children:["
",r(a.p,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Note:"})," For more on device selection and integration, see ",n(a.a,{href:"/en/faq",children:"AR hardware for industrial environments"}),"."]}),"
"]}),"
",r(a.h2,{id:"explore-this-in-your-organisation",children:["Explore this in your organisation",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#explore-this-in-your-organisation",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"AR work instructions make it practical to standardise rare or high risk procedures, improving safety, compliance, and operational confidence. If you manage teams responsible for complex, infrequent tasks, ActARion can help you explore how digital SOPs would work in your context."}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Schedule an exploratory call to discuss your specific procedures, or request a demo focused on a high risk workflow. This is a chance to see the benefits—no commitment required."}),"
",r(a.p,{children:["Learn more about ",n(a.a,{href:"/en/use-cases",children:"AI and AR–guided work instructions"})," or see how ",n(a.a,{href:"/en/ar-preventive-maintenance",children:"digital SOPs support HSE compliance"}),". For background on AR adoption in industry, see ",n(a.a,{href:"https://hbr.org/2022/03/how-ar-is-redefining-industrial-work",children:"Harvard Business Review's overview"}),"."]})]})}return{default:function(e={}){const{wrapper:r}=e.components||{};return r?n(r,{...e,children:n(_createMdxContent,{...e})}):_createMdxContent(e)}};

title: Why the future of work will change
description: How technology, AI and augmented reality are reshaping work, learning and competitive advantage in technical operations.

image.alt: Why the future of work will change

author: Ortwin Verreck
body:
const{Fragment:e,jsx:n,jsxs:r}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(i){const t={a:"a",blockquote:"blockquote",br:"br",h2:"h2",hr:"hr",li:"li",ol:"ol",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...i.components};return r(e,{children:[r(t.h2,{id:"the-future-of-work-started-long-before-ai",children:["The future of work started long before AI",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#the-future-of-work-started-long-before-ai",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"The future of work did not start with AI."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Technology innovation has always been a continuous process that helps organisations work faster, safer and smarter."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"It started the day we put machines between people and their tasks. Ford’s assembly line transformed car building from a craft into a repeatable, standardised process. From that moment on, “technology-scaled labour” became just as important as human skill."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Over the last century, every major wave of technology did something similar: mechanisation, electrification, computers, robotics, software, and now AI. Each wave changed what “productive work” looks like, and rewarded the organisations that adopted it early."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Today we are at a new turning point. AI, combined with augmented reality (AR), is changing how we:"}),"
",r(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Capture and reuse corporate knowledge"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Train and support technical employees"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Scale expertise across sites, shifts and even countries"}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Below I outline four trends that together explain why “faster, safer, smarter” is no longer a nice slogan, but the new baseline."}),"
",n(t.hr,{}),"
",r(t.h2,{id:"trend-1-technology-has-changed-how-we-communicate-and-solve-problems",children:["Trend 1: technology has changed how we communicate and solve problems",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#trend-1-technology-has-changed-how-we-communicate-and-solve-problems",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Most work-related communication no longer runs via the local expert walking over to a machine."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Technicians, planners and engineers now use:"}),"
",r(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Email and messaging apps"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Teams/Zoom and remote support tools"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Ticketing systems and digital service portals"}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Diagnostics that used to be done by a local mechanic are now partly performed by factory analytics systems. The factory learns from usage data, decides when to trigger a recall, and pushes standardised fixes to dealers at scale."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"In many companies, more communication with colleagues, suppliers and OEMs runs through digital channels than via face-to-face conversations or phone calls. For complex problems, several experts (often outside the company) need to be involved at the same time."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"This has two important effects:"}),"
",r(t.ol,{children:["
",r(t.li,{children:["
",r(t.p,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Knowledge scatters"}),n(t.br,{}),"
","Expertise spreads over inboxes, chat histories, meeting recordings and external partners. The better you are at capturing and structuring that knowledge, the faster, smarter and safer you can work."]}),"
"]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:["
",r(t.p,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Speed becomes a differentiator"}),n(t.br,{}),"
","The company that can route a question to the right expert in minutes will beat the one that needs days of internal emails and coordination."]}),"
"]}),"
"]}),"
",r(t.p,{children:["To keep up, organisations need systems that not only connect people, but also ",n(t.strong,{children:"capture and structure what is being said"}),", so it can be reused at scale."]}),"
",n(t.hr,{}),"
",r(t.h2,{id:"trend-2-technology-has-changed-how-we-learn",children:["Trend 2: technology has changed how we learn",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#trend-2-technology-has-changed-how-we-learn",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"For decades, learning at work meant classroom training, binders and thick manuals. We learned by reading text."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"We now know that learning improves when multiple senses are involved: seeing, hearing, movement and touch. That helps explain the rise of online video as a preferred learning format."}),"
",r(t.p,{children:["YouTube has quietly become one of the largest learning platforms in the world. In one survey, 71% of tech employees said they use YouTube as a learning resource, and more than half of B2B buyers use video, including YouTube, to research purchases before making a decision. :contentReference[oaicite:0]",index=0," Video is also one of the fastest-growing formats for internal training and knowledge sharing. :contentReference[oaicite:1]",index=1]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"In other words: traditional manuals are being replaced by searchable, visual, on-demand instructions."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"This again has two effects:"}),"
",r(t.ol,{children:["
",r(t.li,{children:["
",r(t.p,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Technology enables faster learning"}),n(t.br,{}),"
","People are used to instant access to knowledge. They expect short, visual, contextual explanations instead of long documents. Training that uses more senses helps them learn faster and retain more."]}),"
"]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:["
",r(t.p,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Training becomes more individual"}),n(t.br,{}),"
","Employees expect to access exactly the instruction they need, the moment they need it, on the device they have in their hand."]}),"
"]}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"These shifts fit modern learning behaviour, but they introduce a new risk: if you do not structure your own company knowledge, your people will fall back on “random internet advice”. That is a problem for quality, safety and compliance."}),"
",n(t.hr,{}),"
",r(t.h2,{id:"trend-3-technology-adoption-is-accelerating",children:["Trend 3: technology adoption is accelerating",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#trend-3-technology-adoption-is-accelerating",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"A third trend is the speed at which new technology spreads."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Historically, it took decades for technologies like the telephone, electricity or television to reach tens of millions of users. Today, this happens in months, sometimes weeks."}),"
",r(t.p,{children:["ChatGPT is a clear example. It is estimated to have reached around 100 million users within about two months of launch, making it one of the fastest-growing consumer applications in history. :contentReference[oaicite:2]",index=2]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Why do new tools spread so quickly?"}),"
",r(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Digital infrastructure (devices, networks, cloud) is already in place"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"People are used to learning new apps and interfaces"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Business models are designed for rapid global scaling"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Network effects reward early adopters"}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"For companies, this creates a new operational question:"}),"
",r(t.blockquote,{children:["
",n(t.p,{children:"Are we able to adopt new technology fast enough to keep our competitive position?"}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"If your organisation needs years to standardise a new way of working, while competitors roll out AI- or AR-based training and procedures in months, you risk falling behind on productivity, safety and quality."}),"
",n(t.hr,{}),"
",r(t.h2,{id:"trend-4-a-new-labour-market-reality",children:["Trend 4: a new labour market reality",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#trend-4-a-new-labour-market-reality",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"The workforce itself is changing."}),"
",r(t.p,{children:["Many experienced technicians and operators are retiring, taking decades of tacit knowledge with them. At the same time, manufacturers and technical sectors across Europe report persistent difficulties in finding qualified staff, especially for technical and engineering roles. :contentReference[oaicite:3]",index=3]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Younger generations entering the labour market bring different expectations:"}),"
",r(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"They value flexibility, learning opportunities and work-life balance"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"They are more willing to change jobs if they feel unsupported or stuck"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"They are comfortable learning from video and interactive content, and expect modern digital tools"}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Demand for skilled technicians is growing (more automation, more regulation, energy transition), while supply is constrained and more mobile than before."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"The result:"}),"
",r(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Tenure in technical roles decreases"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Vacancies stay open longer"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Corporate knowledge leaks away as people move on"}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"“Hiring more people” or “organising more classroom training” is not enough anymore."}),"
",n(t.hr,{}),"
",r(t.h2,{id:"why-faster-safer-smarter-is-the-new-baseline",children:["Why faster, safer, smarter is the new baseline",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#why-faster-safer-smarter-is-the-new-baseline",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"If we combine these trends, a clear picture emerges:"}),"
",r(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Work is more complex and regulated"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Technology cycles are shorter"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Fewer experienced people stay long enough to pass on their knowledge"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Learning is just-in-time, mobile and video-first"}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"In this context, competitive advantage will belong to companies that:"}),"
",r(t.ol,{children:["
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Capture knowledge systematically"})," instead of letting it live in people’s heads, inboxes and chat histories"]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Deliver knowledge in context"}),", at the moment of need, in a format that fits the task"]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Use technology to make average employees perform like experts"})," on complex work"]}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"That is what “faster, safer, smarter” means in practice:"}),"
",r(t.ul,{children:["
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Faster"}),": employees find and apply the right knowledge immediately"]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Safer"}),": instructions are standardised, up-to-date and auditable"]}),"
